# Neather Launcher

> Free Minecraft launcher for Windows & Linux. High FPS, mods, skins & servers. No sign-up, no paywall.

- Home: https://neatherlauncher.github.io/
- All versions & downloads: https://github.com/neatherlauncher/neatherlauncher.github.io/releases
- Latest: v0.0.1 stable — Windows Portable (.zip, ~25 MB)

## Features

- +15% performance via smart Java flags (FPS Boost config)
- Offline + Ely.by accounts; apply & change skins
- Multiple game instances, one click per version
- 6 modloaders in one click
- Paper & Fabric server setup in one click
- Minecraft tools: gallery + calculators
- Versions from classic 1.0 to the latest release

## How to play (no sign-up)

1. Download for your OS from the Versions section.
2. Create an instance — pick version + modloader.
3. Set a name, hit Play.

## Notes

- Free forever, no subscriptions, no paywalled features.
- Not affiliated with Mojang / Microsoft. Premium-only servers need a paid account.
- Maintained by Shahriar Mahmud.
